stories.title: The 2-5 Buccaneers have outscored their opponents, the only 2-5 team to do so
stories.dek: Tampa Bay is plus-11 on the season, because all 5 of its losses came by 7 or fewer points.
stories.hero_stat: 2-5 record with a plus-11 point differential

stories.title: The Cardinals have allowed 208 points through Week 7, the most in the NFL
stories.dek: Arizona allows 29.7 points per game, and has given up 30 or more in 5 of its 7 games.

stories.title: The 6-0 Vikings are the NFL's only unbeaten team, scoring 20.8 a game
stories.dek: Minnesota scores 20.8 points per game and allows 12.3, against a league average of 23.2.

stories.title: The Titans have scored 58 points through Week 5, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Tennessee is 0-5, but its defense has allowed 109 points, tied for 10th-fewest — the offense is scoring at half the league rate.

stories.title: The Jaguars have allowed 36 points through Week 3, the fewest in the NFL
stories.dek: Jacksonville is 2-1, and its +46 point differential trails only unbeaten San Francisco's.
